rows.commentary: 0.2: Fazalhaq Farooqi tempts the width, catching Brian Bennett's outside edge as the ball races down to third man to get the innings underway.
0.3: Tadiwanashe Marumani leans into a full delivery outside off and crunches it through extra cover, sparking a desperate chase from Rashid Khan near the ropes to save a boundary.
0.4: Fazalhaq Farooqi drops it full at 127.8ks, but Brian Bennett nails his drive straight into the hands of the cover-point fielder.
0.5: Fazalhaq Farooqi offers width once more, and Brian Bennett strides forward to cream it in front of square through a packed off-side field for four.
0.6: Brian Bennett capitalizes on another wide delivery from Fazalhaq Farooqi, opening the face to slice a boundary square on the off-side and cap off a twelve-run opening over.
1.1: Azmatullah Omarzai hits a good length around off stump, handled comfortably on the back foot by Tadiwanashe Marumani into the off-side.
1.2: Azmatullah Omarzai attacks the stumps, forcing Tadiwanashe Marumani back to close the face early and send a leading edge rolling toward cover-point.
1.3: Azmatullah Omarzai targets the hips at 128.3ks, allowing Tadiwanashe Marumani to tuck it away toward square leg for a single.
1.4: Azmatullah Omarzai keeps it close to off at 125.7ks, prompting Brian Bennett to get firmly behind the line and defend.
1.5: Azmatullah Omarzai finds a hint of inward nip on a fractionally short delivery, safely blocked off the back foot by Brian Bennett.
1.6: Azmatullah Omarzai fires one in at 131.1ks that nips back, clipped away by Brian Bennett straight to mid-wicket.
2.1: Fazalhaq Farooqi delivers a 129.5ks fullish ball outside off, firmly defended by Tadiwanashe Marumani toward the cover region.
2.2: Fazalhaq Farooqi drops it full near off, Tadiwanashe Marumani attempts the drive, twisting the bat on contact as the ball squirirts off the inner half toward deep backward square for two.
2.3: Fazalhaq Farooqi hurls down a full, late-swinging inswinger, catching Tadiwanashe Marumani's inside edge as he forces a shot, thudding straight into the front pad.
2.4: Fazalhaq Farooqi persists with the sharp inswinger, forcing Tadiwanashe Marumani to jam his bat down and steer an inside edge away to fine leg.
2.5: Fazalhaq Farooqi fires in a full 128.2 km/h delivery on off stump, and Brian Bennett meets it with a firmly straightened defensive block.
11.3: AM Ghazanfar tosses one drifting into middle and leg, Brendan Taylor clips it uppishly just short of mid-wicket where Ibrahim gathers cleanly on the bounce.
11.4: AM Ghazanfar nails the yorker length once more, allowing Brendan Taylor to jam it out towards long-on for a single.
11.5: AM Ghazanfar fires it quicker and attacks the stumps, prompting Sikandar Raza to prod forward in defense.
11.6: AM Ghazanfar serves up an overpitched delivery and Sikandar Raza punishes it, getting underneath the ball to smoke it a mile over long-on for six.
12.1: Bilal Sami extracts an outside edge with a short delivery outside off, and Rahmanullah Gurbaz takes a straightforward catch behind the stumps to dismiss Brendan Taylor.
12.2: Bilal Sami angles a back of a length delivery across the batter, allowing Ryan Burl to guide it with an open bat face straight to point.
12.3: Bilal Sami pitches short of length around off, and Ryan Burl punches it away with an open face for a single down to third man.
12.4: Bilal Sami drops one back of a length outside off, and Sikandar Raza steers it smoothly down to third man for a run.
12.5: Bilal Sami steams in at 138.1ks with a skiddy delivery attacking the stumps, which Ryan Burl pushes off the inner half toward mid-wicket.
12.6: Bilal Sami targets a good length around off, and Ryan Burl sits back comfortably to defend the ball towards cover.
13.1: AM Ghazanfar darts through a flatter 94.8ks delivery at the stumps, which Sikandar Raza blocks into the pitch to the bowler's right.
13.2: AM Ghazanfar takes pace off with an 87.6ks delivery floated around off, and Sikandar Raza solidly jams it down to the off-side.
13.3: AM Ghazanfar fires it skidding across, Sikandar Raza clears the front leg to work it away, and the ball cannons off the inside edge and pad to scurry backward of square for a leg bye.
13.4: AM Ghazanfar loops it on a good length to Ryan Burl, who plays inside the line as the ball bites back sharply toward the stumps.
13.5: AM Ghazanfar serves a full delivery as Ryan Burl dances down the track, effectively yorking himself before awkwardly stabbing it back to the bowler.
13.6: AM Ghazanfar drifts one slower and wider outside off, allowing Ryan Burl to guide it softly into the off-side and scamper through for a sharp single.
24.1: Mohammad Nabi drifts one in slightly shorter from round the wicket, gently tapped by Ryan Burl toward cover point.
24.2: Mohammad Nabi drops short again, and Sikandar Raza unleashes a fierce back-foot slap into the gap at sweeper cover for two.
24.3: Mohammad Nabi tosses it up on middle, and Sikandar Raza drops to one knee to sweep it directly to square-leg.
24.4: Mohammad Nabi overpitches on off, permitting Sikandar Raza to stroke it smoothly down to long-off for a single.
24.5: Ryan Burl miscues a lofted drive off a well-flighted delivery from Mohammad Nabi, only for Ibrahim Zadran to drop a sitter at long-off, blinded by the glare of the floodlights.
24.6: Mohammad Nabi tosses it up on middle, and Sikandar Raza drives it down to long-on for a single.
25.1: Fazalhaq Farooqi starts off with an off-cutter on the pads, neatly tucked away to backward square leg by Sikandar Raza for one.
25.2: Fazalhaq Farooqi sends down a full delivery angling in, and Ryan Burl meets it with a solid drive straight to mid-off.
25.3: Ryan Burl thwacks the fuller ball hard down the track, forcing Farooqi to get a hand to it while a struggling, panting Raza hits the turf.
25.4: Fazalhaq Farooqi introduces a well-disguised slower delivery that leaves Ryan Burl swinging wildly and missing completely.
25.5: Fazalhaq Farooqi keeps it back of a length with a slower variation, and Ryan Burl works it across to mid-wicket.
25.6: Fazalhaq Farooqi caps off an exceptional over by angling one in from a length, safely blocked to the covers by Ryan Burl.
26.1: Mohammad Nabi tosses it up on middle and stretches his right leg to stop Raza's drive, inadvertently causing Burl to fall down.
26.2: Mohammad Nabi drifts one in from outside off, and Sikandar Raza quietly works it away to midwicket.
26.3: Sikandar Raza drops to one knee and sweeps Mohammad Nabi to backward square leg, bringing up a hard-fought, well-deserved fifty.
26.4: Ryan Burl miscues a half-tracker from Mohammad Nabi straight into the air, allowing Bilal Sami to charge in and take a sharp diving catch at deep square-leg.
26.5: Mohammad Nabi delivers, and Madhevere collects a single down to long-on.
37.4: Rashid Khan flirts dangerously past Blessing Muzarabani's inside edge, leaving Nabi aghast at slip.
37.5: Rashid Khan pins Blessing Muzarabani down as the batsman dead-bats it towards mid-wicket.
37.6: Rashid Khan's googly beats everyone including Gurbaz, racing for four byes down leg while a frustrated bowler stares down his keeper.
38.1: Wellington Masakadza crouches low against Mohammad Nabi and sweeps it high over mid-wicket to hustle back for two.
38.2: Mohammad Nabi floats a short delivery that Wellington Masakadza promptly taps towards cover.
38.3: Mohammad Nabi straightens one past Wellington Masakadza's probing outside edge.
38.4: Mohammad Nabi slides one down leg past the glance and past Gurbaz's gloves, gifting Zimbabwe three wides.
38.4: Mohammad Nabi tosses it near off, and Wellington Masakadza pushes it solidly into the off-side.
38.5: Mohammad Nabi finds a full length on off, met by Wellington Masakadza's watchful forward defense.
38.6: Wellington Masakadza chips it uppishly towards Mohammad Nabi, who dives sharply to his right to smother the ball.
39.1: Rashid Khan errs full and straight, allowing Blessing Muzarabani to whip it square and scamper for two runs.
39.2: Rashid Khan loops a leg-break onto the stumps, safely tucked away to mid-wicket by Blessing Muzarabani.
39.3: Rashid Khan drifts the googly past the swinging bat of Blessing Muzarabani to strike him flush on the pad.
39.4: Rashid tosses up another wrong 'un as Muzarabani halves the forward block safely towards the leg side.
39.5: Rashid begs an unsuccessful review after an angled delivery beats Muzarabani's inside edge to strike the pad outside leg.
39.6: Muzarabani crouches low beneath the flighted ball and dispatches a booming slog sweep over square leg for four.
40.1: Mohammad Nabi darts one in quickly from around the wicket, forcing Wellington Masakadza back to punch it straight to cover.
40.2: Dot ball from Mohammad Nabi to Wellington Masakadza.
0.4: Blessing Muzarabani zeros in on middle with a good-length delivery, met by the full face of Ibrahim Zadran's bat as he strides forward to push it toward mid-on.
0.5: Blessing Muzarabani offers a tight back-of-a-length ball on off, which Ibrahim Zadran retreats onto the back foot to punch straight back to the bowler.
0.6: Ibrahim Zadran works a short-of-length delivery outside off off the back foot with mistimed force, allowing Wellington Masakadaza to misfield at cover and leak a single.
1.1: Brad Evans attacks with a full delivery angling into off, inviting Ibrahim Zadran forward to present the full face in a drive toward mid-on.
1.2: Brad Evans serves a fourth-stump half-volley, and Ibrahim Zadran unleashes a wristy flick powered by his bottom hand that bisects mid-wicket and mid-on for four.
1.3: Brad Evans pitches full on off, catching the higher portion of Ibrahim Zadran's forward-driven bat as the ball trickles out to cover.
1.4: Brad Evans errs too full and straight on middle and leg, leaving Ibrahim Zadran to stride forward and whip it aerially over mid-wicket for his second consecutive boundary.
1.5: Brad Evans slides one full just outside off, met by Ibrahim Zadran's straight bat before being driven fiercely back to the bowler who shapes to throw.

1.6: Brad Evans fires it in short, Ibrahim Zadran ducks his head beneath the line before whipping a pull wide of mid-wicket, racing back for a hard-run triple as the ball pulls up just short of the ropes.
2.1: Blessing Muzarabani extracts lift from a rising length outside off, catching Ibrahim Zadran's thick inside edge off a standing punch as it strikes his right leg and rolls away.
2.2: Blessing Muzarabani hits a hard length angled into the stumps, and Ibrahim Zadran strides forward to push it toward mid-on.

2.3: Blessing Muzarabani beats a diving Brendan Taylor as an ungainly, premeditated back-foot pull from Ibrahim Zadran takes a thick inside edge off a short delivery outside off to race away for a streaky boundary.
2.4: Blessing Muzarabani pitches it full outside off, and Ibrahim Zadran strides forward to punch the off-drive cleanly straight to the fielder at mid-off.
2.5: Blessing Muzarabani angles a fuller delivery into off stump, and Ibrahim Zadran presents the full face of the bat for a crisp on-drive directly to mid-on.
2.6: Blessing Muzarabani targets middle stump on a good length, allowing Ibrahim Zadran to nudge it toward mid-on and scamper safely through as the bowler's end throw misses.
3.1: Brad Evans drops it back outside off, and Ibrahim Zadran cracks it fiercely on the rise past backward point where Madhevere fails to cleanly halt the flashing stroke.
3.2: Brad Evans attacks the stumps on a good length, forcing Rahmanullah Gurbaz to solidly defend from inside the line.
3.3: Brad Evans delivers on the stumps at a length, enabling Gurbaz to turn it around the corner toward square leg for a single.
3.4: Brad Evans serves up a fullish delivery just outside off, and Ibrahim Zadran gets forward to dead-bat it with the full face toward cover.
13.2: Newman Nyamhuri serves it full outside off, and Ibrahim Zadran crouches slightly to square-drive it past backward point for a single.
13.3: Newman Nyamhuri digs in a short delivery outside off that catches Sediqullah Atal on the pull, ballooning a top-edge straight to Brendan Taylor.
13.4: Newman Nyamhuri drops it full outside off, fishing in that probing corridor of uncertainty as Rahmat Shah lets it pass.
13.5: Newman Nyamhuri slides it full outside off, prompting Rahmat Shah forward to drive square before Madhevere cuts it off with a sharp dive to his right at backward point.
13.6: Newman Nyamhuri targets a short of length on leg-stump, forcing Rahmat Shah back to pull it off the glove down to fine-leg for his first run.
14.1: Wellington Masakadza tosses up a flat good length outside off, and Rahmat Shah steps back to punch firmly toward the covers.
14.2: Wellington Masakadza floats a slower, full delivery on middle, inviting Rahmat Shah to stride forward and push it down towards long-off.
14.3: Wellington Masakadza delivers a full ball on middle, allowing Ibrahim Zadran to lean ahead and stroke it straight to long-off.
14.4: Wellington Masakadza fires it quicker on a good length just outside off, catching Rahmat Shah on the back foot to punch straight to backward point.
14.5: Wellington Masakadza smartly pulls back his length as Rahmat Shah advances down the track, leaving the batter to bunt it tamely back to the bowler.
14.6: Wellington Masakadza offers a slower, fuller trajectory outside off, and Rahmat Shah steps forward to drive cleanly into the extra-cover region.
15.1: Newman Nyamhuri bangs it short of length outside off, and Ibrahim Zadran drops back to carve it wide of backward point for a quick run.
15.2: Newman Nyamhuri drops it short, and Rahmat Shah steps back to drop his hands and steer it firmly into the turf toward backward point.
15.3: Newman Nyamhuri digs it in short again, and Rahmat Shah swivels to pull it hard, collecting a single as it skips on one bounce to the deep fielder.
15.4: Newman Nyamhuri spears a full delivery in at the leg stump, allowing Ibrahim Zadran to stride forward and clip it away into the deep square-leg region.
15.5: Newman Nyamhuri rolls his fingers across a slower length delivery outside off, and Rahmat Shah punches it square through the off-side to hustle back for a pair.
15.6: Newman Nyamhuri lets slip a towering full-toss that Rahmat Shah defensively bats back down the pitch, immediately turning to question the square-leg umpire about its height.
30.4: Sikandar Raza drifts the off-break into leg-stump as Rahmat Shah retreats onto the back foot to punch a single cleanly down to long-off.
30.5: Sikandar Raza feeds a good length on off, allowing Ibrahim Zadran to drop deep and execute a short-arm jab that splits the three ring-fielders on the leg-side for a single.
30.6: Sikandar Raza loops this full delivery right into middle, and Rahmat Shah steps forward to flick it straight into the hands of mid-wicket.
31.1: Ryan Burl attacks from a flat good length just outside off, prompting Ibrahim Zadran to punch it past the bowler where a missed opportunity allows a single.
31.2: Ryan Burl tosses up a full delivery outside off, and Rahmat Shah strides forward to stroke it firmly out toward sweeper cover.
31.3: Ryan Burl serves a full ball on off, meeting a solid forward defense from Ibrahim Zadran played neatly to the bowler's right.
31.4: Ryan Burl delivers a flat good length outside off that Ibrahim Zadran pulls off the back foot straight to a positioned short mid-wicket.
31.5: Ryan Burl pushes a seam-up full delivery on off back down the pitch, safely collected by the bowler after Ibrahim Zadran's straight drive.
31.6: Ryan Burl entices Ibrahim Zadran into a booming slog-sweep on full off, but the batsman miscues off the bottom edge directly to short mid-wicket.
32.1: Madhevere gets an off-break to turn sharply in on a flat good length, forcing Rahmat Shah onto the back foot to successfully defend it back.
32.2: Madhevere drops it short with sharp turn from outside off, enabling Rahmat Shah to back away and steer an untimed cut out to long-off.
32.3: Madhevere tosses it fully up on off, and Ibrahim Zadran strides forward to drive it comfortably out to long-on for a run.
32.4: Madhevere floats this slower delivery outside off, turning sharply back in as Rahmat Shah retreats to dead-bat it toward mid-wicket.
32.5: Madhevere strikes as Rahmat Shah pulls aerially to mid-wicket where Ryan Burl launches himself horizontally to pluck out an astonishing one-handed stunner.
32.6: Madhevere drags this short delivery across off, allowing Hashmatullah Shahidi to slice a cut straight to the fielder stationed at point.
33.1: Ryan Burl angles it in from the front of the hand on a good length, and Ibrahim Zadran whips it straight to mid-wicket.
33.2: Ryan Burl spears a straight leg-break into the stumps, defended cleanly off the back foot by Ibrahim Zadran.
33.3: Ryan Burl dives sharply to his right to intercept Ibrahim Zadran's firm back-foot push.
33.4: Ryan Burl floats a full delivery on off, driven down to long-on for a comfortable single by Ibrahim Zadran.
33.5: Ryan Burl attacks the leg-stump with a slip in place, allowing Hashmatullah Shahidi to work a single into the vacant square-leg pocket.
33.6: Ryan Burl darts a flat good-length ball outside off, stabbed straight to cover-point by Ibrahim Zadran.
34.1: Wessly Madhevere tosses one up outside off, punched firmly off the back foot to backward point by Hashmatullah Shahidi.
34.2: Wessly Madhevere draws a thick outside edge from Hashmatullah Shahidi, scampering back for a sharp couple of runs.
34.3: Hashmatullah Shahidi unleashes a fierce cut past the diving fielder to seal victory, sparking joyous celebrations as Afghanistan claim the tri-series.

preview.text: Zimbabwe won the toss and chose to bat first against Afghanistan in the one-day match at Sharjah Cricket Stadium. The usual first-innings score in the 11 recorded one-day matches at Sharjah Cricket Stadium is 247. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 34 degrees.

summary.text: Afghanistan won the match by 7 wickets after restricting ZIM to 169-10, where Sikandar Raza top scored with 68 off 83 balls and Rashid Khan took 3 for 41. In response, AFG chased the target by reaching 170-3, led by Ibrahim Zadran with 70 off 96 balls while Newman Nyamhuri claimed 2 for 30.
